main.description: Take someone off a roster. An owner removes anyone; anyone removes themselves, which is also how an invitation is declined and how a member leaves.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such member, or the caller is not a member of that context.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The row is someone else's and the caller is not an owner.

errors.name: LastOwner
errors.description: It would leave the context with no owner who can sign in.
